claims.text: A 74-year-old woman with a past medical history of hypothyroidism on levothyroxine was brought to the emergency department after being found unconscious at home. She had altered mental status, hypothermia (93 degrees Fahrenheit) and hypertension (185/97 mm Hg). Admission laboratory tests showed leukocytosis, serum sodium 163 mmol/L, creatinine 3.47 mg/dL, TSH 168 mIU/mL and free T4 0.33 ng/dL, and her ECG showed ST elevations in the anterior leads.
